cards.flavorText: Some say tales of the Narnam greenhouse are told to scare the children, but every tale grows from a seed of truth.

cards.text:
Trample, haste
Crew 1 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 1 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)
cards.flavorText: It'll either crash or win the race. Possibly both.

cards.name: Panharmonicon
cards.text: If an artifact or creature entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.flavorText: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

cards.name: Perpetual Timepiece
cards.text:
{T}: Mill two cards. (Put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)
{2}, Exile this artifact: Shuffle any number of target cards from your graveyard into your library.
cards.flavorText: Do not be so caught up in keeping track of time that you forget to make use of it.

cards.flavorText: Not a mote of dust escapes the dutiful cleaners that keep the exclusive Prakhata Club immaculate.

cards.text:
When this artifact enters, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: To understand Kaladesh, one must first understand how aether and invention flow together through the great Aether Cycle.

Crew 2 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 2 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)

cards.text:
This creature can't block.

cards.flavorText: Some machines refuse to accept their own obsolescence.

cards.text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an Assembly-Worker creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
